Worked Example

Someone born on March 15, 1990 is, on November 22, 2026, 36 years, 8 months and 7 days old. That is 13,401 days in total. Age is counted as completed years, so you turn a year older on your birthday, not before.

Leap Day Birthdays

People born on February 29 have a birthday only in leap years. In non-leap years the legal birthday varies by state and context, often treated as February 28 or March 1.

Uses and Related Tools

  • Add or subtract time with the date calculator.
  • Many age-based rules, such as retirement benefits, use exact ages; check with the agency. See the retirement calculator.

extra_faqs.q: How do I calculate my age in days?
extra_faqs.a: Subtract the birth date from today. The calculator counts every day, including leap days.

extra_faqs.q: How old will I be on a future date?
extra_faqs.a: Enter the future date in the comparison field to see your age on that day.

extra_faqs.q: Is age counted differently in some countries?
extra_faqs.a: Yes. Some countries use traditional systems that count a person as one at birth. The US counts completed years.
